Project-authored coverage fixtures, GPL-3.0-only.

prior-coverage-fnv64.txt freezes unmodified OdyTTY geometric coverage before
polygon changes, SHA f8db7b0ac25a67ff2a5f01ea2c1ae033b171b34c. Its boxdraw.rs
is identical to 2436a410. Records are codepoint, width, height, and FNV-1a-64
of every pixel, for all 760 previously covered glyphs at five cell sizes.
Never regenerate this baseline from a changed renderer. One deliberate
correction replaced only the rows of 282 code points: the 54 sextants and
218 octants whose cells had been drawn transposed, the 8 triangular blocks
U+1FB68..U+1FB6F, and U+1FB82 and U+1FB87, which had been drawn as one eighth
instead of one quarter. Those shapes are checked independently against the
Unicode names by tests/legacy_computing_names.rs. Every other row is
unchanged.

diagonal-area-coverage.txt is an independent rational-area reference generated
from four project-authored polygons defined by the Unicode character names:
U+1FB3C: (0, 2h/3), (w/2, h), (0, h).
U+1FB3D: (0, 2h/3), (w, h), (0, h).
U+1FB40: (0, 0), (w/2, h), (0, h).
U+1FB50: (0, 0), (w/2, 0), (w, h), (0, h).
Each pixel clips that polygon to its unit square and uses round(area * 255).
Records are codepoint, width, height, and row-major byte coverage in hex.
These expectations were not generated by OdyTTY's production renderer.

Cell sizes: 6x12, 9x18, 11x23, 12x24, 18x36. Relative to 9x18 these exercise
2/3, 1, rounded 1.25, 4/3, and 2 pixel scale factors. These are raster tests,
not device-level HiDPI acceptance.
